description: A Space Mission Design Game is an educational game where players design and manage a space mission. Players choose a spacecraft, plan the mission, manage fuel and resources, and overcome challenges to successfully reach a target in space. It helps develop problem-solving, creativity, decision-making, and basic knowledge of space technology.
summary: The Space Mission Design Game is an interactive educational simulation—featured in initiatives like the NASA Space Apps Challenge—that challenges players to plan, build, and operate a complete spacecraft or space exploration mission.
